## Summary
Abhay Vishwakarma is an Indian systems engineer, researcher, and developer specializing in:
- Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) Perception & Avionics
- Offline & Edge Neural Intelligence Architectures
- Tactical Ground Control Stations (GCS) & Telemetry
- Deterministic Reliability Engineering & Self-Healing Systems

## Flagship Engineering Systems

### 1. Aerial Intelligence Munitions (A.I.M.)
- **Category:** Autonomous UAV Systems & Aerial Robotics
- **Architecture:** Two-tier autonomous UAV architecture decoupling high-altitude standoff aerial perception from agile waypoint navigation.
- **Key Technical Capabilities:** Real-time YOLOv8 object detection on aerial video; mathematical ray-projection engine intersecting camera attitude transforms with WGS-84 Earth ellipsoid to derive geolocated coordinates; low-latency ESP-NOW radio relay.
- **Verification:** Hardware-in-the-loop autonomous MAVLink waypoint handover with sub-second coordinate resolution in flight tests.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/AbhayLabs-07/Aerial-Intelligence-Munitions-A.I.M-

### 2. MEDHA AI
- **Category:** Offline Neural Intelligence & Edge Computing
- **Architecture:** Private, air-gapped local intelligence agent running on consumer x86 hardware without cloud telemetry or external API calls.
- **Key Technical Capabilities:** Feed-forward neural network written from scratch in pure Python; acoustic wake-word classification; MFCC voice biometrics; Playwright CDP and Windows UIAutomation orchestration.
- **Verification & Performance:** 71 automated tests passing; sub-50ms local neural intent classification with zero external network latency.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/AbhayLabs-07/MEDHA-AI

### 3. RecoverOps AI
- **Category:** Systems Reliability & Fault Recovery
- **Architecture:** Deterministic workflow execution engine replacing naive infinite retry loops with closed fault taxonomy classification and bounded recovery budgets.
- **Key Technical Capabilities:** Zero-dependency Python core; path-jailed filesystem sandboxing; declarative state assertions; transactional audit logging via SQLite.
- **Verification:** 76 automated unit and fault-simulation tests passing across network dropouts, corrupt payloads, and missing dependencies.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/AbhayLabs-07/recoverops-ai.git

### 4. Sentinel GCS
- **Category:** Avionics, Telemetry & Flight Control
- **Architecture:** Cross-platform tactical UAV Ground Control Station for mission planning, real-time telemetry, and safety interlocks.
- **Key Technical Capabilities:** React 18 HUD with 3D MapLibre GL terrain; compiled Rust MAVLink 2.0 telemetry core; Android Tauri v2 container; USB OTG radio bridge up to 921,600 baud.
- **Verification:** 194-test regression suite passing across 15 test suites with verified flight-critical safety interlocks.
- **Repository:** https://github.com/AbhayLabs-07/sentinel.git
